items.title: The cap action on the cycle class of a flat coherent sheaf against a coherent cycle class
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file relative-cycles.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: 14 行陈述（57 行证明）、平坦凝聚层的循环类对凝聚层循环类的帽作用：支撑并集计算保定义、构造记号识别分支归约到一般点长度恒等式、长度恒等式用平坦性加法性归约到剩余域情形即得。proof 零外部引用全自足，statement 2 处引用全具名，无 omit，干净收。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-action-coherent (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 2358-2371

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: Compute the support of the tensor product as the union over the support of the second sheaf of the fibre supports, giving a closed subset of the sum delta-dimension so the displayed cycle class is defined, identify the irreducible components appearing in the cap product with those of the support of the tensor product of the sum dimension using the notation of the construction, reduce to a length identity at the generic points of those components, translate the identity into an equality between the length of a tensor product of a finite length module with a flat module and the product of the lengths of its reductions, use flatness to see both sides are additive in the finite length module, and conclude with the residue field case where the identity is immediate (source lines 2373-2429)
